facts.title: hazard report during shift handover on P-4103

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control HYDROCARBON_TRANSFER_CONTROL: the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next field verification that the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels on P-4103, M-4103 and V-4110 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in responding to a loss of containment, specifically isolating and depressuring a leaking system. P-4103 (hydrocarbon transfer pumps) is in service for hydrocarbon transfer, single mechanical seal with pressurised barrier-fluid support. The task proceeded during shift handover while the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels was in place but did not perform. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 4 June 2013 a hazard report was recorded on P-4103, M-4103 and V-4110 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during shift handover; chemical energy held as hydrocarbon was not released.
